//: Template for a capture target - copy to targets/<name>.json. Secrets go in targets/<name>.local.json (gitignored) or .env via env: references.
name: my-app
description: the production web app, as a demo admin
//startUrl: where captures start when a scene names no start (relative to app)
//pageUrlMatch: extra hosts that still count as the app (SSO, identity provider)
//blockUrls: kept from loading during a capture: chat widgets, surveys
//hideSelectors: hidden with CSS: banners unrelated to any feature
//blurSelectors: blurred with CSS: contact names, phone numbers, emails - anything personal
//profile: Chrome profile holding the signed-in session. Default profiles/<name>/. For SSO apps sign in once by hand: node pipeline/rollout.mjs login <name>

auth.//mode: 'none': use the profile's session (SSO). 'form': fill the login form off camera whenever it appears.
auth.//selectors: puppeteer selectors or 'btn:Exact text'. signedIn proves the app has loaded.

//secrets: values filled into {name} placeholders in scene URLs, e.g. start: /workspaces/{workspaceId}/settings
